subject: Vacancy replenishment: Sr Data Infrastructure (attrition) — comp band & headcount signoff
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vacancy replenishment: Sr Data Infrastructure (attrition) — comp band & headcount signoff

Team —

Quick heads-up: Vlad from Data Infra resigned last week (effective 11/30). We need formal signoff to refill the headcount and to confirm the compensation band if we relevel the role to Sr (SDE4 equivalent). Attached: JD_Senior_Data_Infrastructure.pdf with the updated scope (adds streaming infra ownership).

Options I see:
- Refill at the same level (band 4) — faster, lower budget impact
- Relevel to band 5 (Sr) — wider search window, likely external hire, stronger impact on throughput

I prefer relevel to band 5 given the streaming ownership, but will take input on cost and approval path. Hiring urgency: want interviews scheduled by 12/10 to avoid slider on deliverables.

Ask: Laura, can you post and start candidate outreach if comp is cleared? Neha/Priya/Rishi — need signoff on band 5 + one-time flex (up to 2%) for offers and a spot hiring bonus if needed.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Data Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachment: JD_Senior_Data_Infrastructure.pdf (1 page)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vacancy replenishment: Sr Data Infrastructure (attrition) — comp band & headcount signoff

Thanks Markus — looping in TalentOps for external sourcing and noting internal mobility channels. Quick notes:
- I can draft the posting today. For speed, we can post as band 4.5 (if governance allows) or band 5. If Neha confirms band 5, I will open requisition as Senior Data Infrastructure Eng (band 5).
- Do we want to prioritize internal transfers first? I ran a quick query; there are two internal candidates in adjacent infra teams who could move.
- Attaching a snapshot: candidate_pipeline_snapshot.csv with two internal prospects and one external recruiter lead (Ian Walker at Acme AI).

If we go internal transfer -> we should label this as a backfill, not a net-new headcount. If external, we should confirm the budget delta.

Happy to kick off interviews once comp is confirmed.

Laura Bennett
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference

Attachment: candidate_pipeline_snapshot.csv
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vacancy replenishment: Sr Data Infrastructure (attrition) — comp band & headcount signoff

Hi all — reviewed the JD and current labor budgets. Key guidance:
- Banding: Band 5 is acceptable for this role given the expanded scope (streaming + ownership).
- Offer structure: base + equity + 10% target bonus. If you want a spot hiring bonus, cap it at one-time 5,000 USD for external hires.
- Flex: approving a one-time up to 2% base flex above midpoint for exceptional candidates, to be documented on Greenlight and routed to me for final sign-off.

Implication: moving to band 5 increases budgeted run-rate ~9% for this line. Please confirm that the team can absorb this (Markus). I attached comp_guidelines_Q4.pdf with the formal parameters.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Compensation & Benefits
Redwood Inference

Attachment: comp_guidelines_Q4.pdf
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vacancy replenishment: Sr Data Infrastructure (attrition) — comp band & headcount signoff

Markus / team —

From a People & Mobility perspective:
- Prefer internal transfer where possible (shorter ramp, knowledge continuity). If you identify an internal candidate who meets the scope, file as an internal backfill with Talent Mobility and we can expedite.
- If external, please document: reason for external (skill gap) and expected ramp timeline. This is required for audit trail and for forecasting the hiring freeze exceptions.
- Please confirm whether this is a replacement (backfill) or a growth headcount — this will affect approvals.

If you decide to relevel to band 5 and proceed externally, ensure we obtain Neha's comp sign-off (already provided), and route package to Rishi for budget clearance.

Priya Natarajan
People Partner, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vacancy replenishment: Sr Data Infrastructure (attrition) — comp band & headcount signoff

Thanks everyone — updates:
- We do not have an internal candidate with the streaming + infra ops experience I need. Laura, please proceed with external posting as band 5.
- I accept Neha's comp guidance; will aim for offers in band 5 with the 10% target bonus. Requesting approval for a one-time 2% base flex and a discretionary spot hire bonus up to $5k if needed to close.
- Rishi — please confirm budget availability. This is a replacement (backfill) for Vlad; not net-new. I want to keep this as replacement headcount to avoid greenlight escalation.

Also looping in Ian Walker (external recruiter contact) to accelerate external candidates:
> Ian Walker <ian.walker@acme.ai>

Laura — please start scheduling interviews and share first slate by 12/08.

Markus

Subject: Re: Vacancy replenishment: Sr Data Infrastructure (attrition) — comp band & headcount signoff

Markus / team —

Finance note: I reviewed the cost delta and the 2026 hiring plan. Since this is a replacement (backfill) for an existing headcount, we can absorb the band 5 uplift within the current team budget for Q4/Q1, and approve the one-time up to 2% base flex for market-competitive offers.

Conditions:
- Please document the hire as "replacement/backfill" in Greenlight and link to HRREQ-4821.
- Any spot hiring bonus must be below $5k and recorded in the offer paperwork.
- Notify finance after offer acceptance so we can update run-rate and headcount reports.

I am attaching a short finance approval note: finance_approval_note.pdf. Consider this signoff for recruiting to proceed.

Rishi Malhotra
Finance Manager, Talent Planning
Redwood Inference
